decisions.quote: All the author replication codes run and reproduce the results reported in the paper, except for minor discrepancies in the reported standard errors in Tables 4 and 5. The differences in Tables 4 and 5 do not change statistical significance; only the last digit is off, i.e., .001 for most estimates.
decisions.reason: The original code reproduces the reported tables with only negligible last-digit (.001) differences in standard errors that do not affect significance, and the authors explicitly conclude that the code is computationally reproducible.
